description: A black USB hub with several ports sits on the green bedspread in front of a large dark pillow, with a short white USB adapter plugged into the hub. The left hand slides in from the left to steady the USB hub as a left-hand object, while the right hand comes in from the right, pinches the white USB adapter as a right-hand object, pulls it upward and slightly right to unplug it, and then sets it down on the bed behind the hub.
